data.one_liner: Disables automatic screen off and prevents the screen from turning off.
data.what_it_does: This plugin prevents the device screen from automatically turning off. It provides methods to turn the keep-screen-on feature on or off, check its status, and manage platform-specific Android flags.
use_when: You are building an app where the screen needs to stay active during usage like reading or presentations.
You need programmatic control over screen timeout behavior on Android and iOS.
avoid_when: You want a declarative widget-based solution to control screen behavior.
You are looking for screen wake-lock features outside of Android and iOS.
strengths: Simple API to turn the screen lock on and off.
Supports fine-grained Android-specific flags like FLAG_ALLOW_LOCK_WHILE_SCREEN_ON.
weaknesses: Requires manual cleanup in dispose methods to prevent the screen from staying on indefinitely.
Some methods and features are only available on Android.
